we have developed a novel approach for the treatment of symptomatic carid in-stent restenosis.
the stent implantation for symptomatic carotids in-stent restenosis is safe and effective, with a very low rate of major stroke and TIA.

The main takeaway from our work is that
we should not forget the importance of the stent type and size in the management of caro-tid ISS.
, when treating symptomatic ISS with a balloon-expandable DES, the stent must be deployed in the distal part of the stent to avoid the risk of slippage.
